original_adjacent_join_policy: Every body pair was executed. Adjacency is reported, never used to skip testing. Every changed adjacent witness remains an unvalidated source-cap observation and blocks future acceptance until bounded against original native joint-cap geometry. Adjacency grants no waiver. This endpoint already fails nonadjacent/cart witnesses.
limitations: Finite native triangle inward and edge/triangle probes are not an exhaustive collision certificate.
No new pose, production solver or admitted primitive is emitted when a forbidden native witness remains.
No impossibility claim. Closest candidate is a concrete source-limited IK endpoint with rejected native witnesses.
No rest-to-grip/release trajectory, gait, balance, force, engine or warehouse admission.
Wider contacts and small genuine TorsoX changes did not produce a clear endpoint in this bounded local study. This is not a proof of impossibility.
Reported micrometre depths are the two native surface distances at shared-interior witnesses, not maximum penetration or minimum translation distance.

Changed adjacent joint-cap witnesses are retained without a blanket adjacency waiver; spatial source-cap certification was not completed because the endpoint fails independent nonadjacent/cart checks.
gate_joint_limit_method: Active-set feasible LM steps against original native limits; final values are verified, never post-clamped. Earlier bounded numerical search uses unchanged historical projected solver, whose source is pinned separately.

source_cap_validation.scope: All body pairs were executed and their witnesses retained. No linked-pair observation is waived; no acceptance is emitted while source-cap spatial validation is incomplete.

body_drop_study.reason: Static endpoint still has native forbidden witnesses; no arm-only drop result presented as solved feet.
